name: Escape to Shanghai
summary:
A young girl escapes from Nazi Germany to Shanghai, China, but her story of survival was only beginning.

Escape to Shanghai follows Doris Fogel's epic journey from Nazi Germany to Shanghai, China, making a temporary home and a new life cut off from the horrors playing out in occupied Europe. Filmed on location in Shanghai, Chicago, and Berlin, Doris's story is brought to life using 360° video technology alongside 3D environments, animation, motion capture, and a spatial soundtrack. 

Created by the Illinoi
